description: This file defines an abstract base class for AMQP endpoints within the Hono framework, handling connection and link management, configuration, and some protocol-specific behaviors.

classes.name: AbstractAmqpEndpoint
classes.description: An abstract base class for AMQP endpoints in the Hono framework, providing link management, configuration, and connection handling functionalities.

methods.name: AbstractAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing the endpoint with a Vertx instance.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration properties for the endpoint.

methods.name: onLinkDetach
methods.description: Closes a link to a ProtonReceiver, optionally with an error condition.

methods.name: onLinkDetach
methods.description: Closes a link to a ProtonLink (either receiver or sender), with optional error condition.

methods.name: onLinkAttach
methods.description: Handles attachment of a receiver link, rejecting unsupported operations.

methods.name: onLinkAttach
methods.description: Handles attachment of a sender link, rejecting unsupported operations.

methods.name: passesFormalVerification
methods.description: Abstract method to verify the validity of a message based on protocol criteria.
